situations.headline: Ingenia rejects unsolicited $4.75/share cash bid from Warburg Pincus

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Ingenia rejects unsolicited $4.75/share cash bid from Warburg Pincus (interest 7, risk 4)

thesis.text: Ingenia is now an active take-private target with a rejected $4.75/share cash bid from Warburg Pincus establishing a valuation floor/reference point; upside depends on whether Warburg Pincus (or another party) returns with a higher, binding offer, or whether the pending Peet Limited acquisition proceeds and is value-accretive as the Board asserts. Key risks are deal-break (Peet deal falls through, bidder walks) and valuation uncertainty absent a firm offer; monitor for revised proposals, Peet transaction updates, and any board recommendation changes.
